format.description: false disables every format and check call; a map replaces the built-in commands per language.

lint.description: false disables every lint call; a map replaces the built-in lint command per language.

test.description: false disables every test run of Invoke-Tests.ps1; a map sets the test command per language (precedence: this key, package.json scripts.test, the default of the detected test tool).

checks.description: Cheap static repository checks (ratchets, line counts, doc paths). implementation runs the ones with fast: true before the targeted tests and after every fix.

gate.description: The gate command check:changed (references/gate.md): a command string, or false for no gate.

governance.description: Architecture decisions and specs; read by adr, github-issue, planner, implementation, code-review, deliver, detect-techstack and the CI checks adr and spec of GravionLabs/ci.

adrPaths.description: Globs of paths whose change needs an ADR.

specMap.description: Glob of source paths -> spec file.

contracts.description: Contract files (SPEC, schemas, fixtures, CLI help); deliver step 6 labels the PBI contract-change when its PR touches one.

paths.description: Globs of the contract paths (** any depth, * within a segment).

release.description: Release candidate and RC test; read by deliver (step 9) and github-release finish.

prerelease.description: Command that cuts a release candidate, e.g. gh workflow run release.yml --ref release/next -f prerelease=true.

platforms.description: Platforms of the RC test, e.g. ["macOS", "Linux", "Windows"]; with template, github-milestone create/insert makes the release-test issue.

template.description: Body template of the release-test issue ({milestone}, {platforms}), e.g. docs/manual-acceptance.md or .github/release-test.md.

gate.description: true: no release PR while the release-test issue is open (default false).

deliver.description: Settings of deliver. Other keys of the old loop (roles, loopThreshold, parallel, sessionTimeoutMinutes) are ignored with a warning.

base.description: The base branch of the pull requests (default: release/next with --milestone, else the default branch).

tracker.description: Name of the tracker, scripts/tracker/<name>.mts (default github).

harness.description: The agent CLI: claude (default) or copilot.

protectedPaths.description: A pull request that changes one of these paths is not merged by the loop; replaces the default list.

fast.description: true: runs before the targeted tests and after every fix (default false: the entry is only listed).

targeted.description: Command of the targeted run per commit; {files} is replaced by the test files of the changed paths.
